[Compare plans & benefits > FAQs > How do I become a Premium or Generation client?]

You’ll automatically become a Premium client when you reach $100,000 with Wealthsimple.

…

[Compare plans & benefits > FAQs > What counts towards the $100,000 or $500,000 minimums?]

Your status is determined by whichever is higher — the value of your net deposits, or the value of your entire Wealthsimple portfolio.

…

[Compare plans & benefits > FAQs > What happens if my net deposits and my total assets go below $100,000 or $500,000?]

If both your net deposits and total assets with Wealthsimple fall and stay below the $100,000 or $500,000 minimum you will be subject to a change in status.
